item.title: Palash Muchhal: Lawyer Responds to Fraud Allegations Against the Composer
item.description: Palash Muchhal: Singer-composer Palash Muchhal has been in the news continuously after his breakup with cricketer Smriti Mandhana. Meanwhile, actor-producer Vidyan Mane has leveled serious allegations against him. Vidyan claims that before their marriage, Palash was caught red-handed with another woman, after which he was allegedly beaten. Furthermore, he has filed a complaint in Sangli, Maharashtra, accusing him of defrauding him of over ₹40 lakh in the name of investing in an unreleased film.
